outputs.content:
Yes — TernDB's price has changed since Nov 3. ValeSQL's can't be confirmed as a change.

**TernDB Launch (US, monthly billing):** $19/month on Nov 3 → **$24/month** now, with the pricing update effective November 8, 2026 [S1](https://tern-current.example/pricing). That's a $5/month increase (+26%). Old value: [tern-old](https://tern-old.example/pricing).

**ValeSQL Launch (US, monthly billing):** currently **$17/month** [S2](https://vale-current.example/pricing). I have no confirmed Nov 3 price for ValeSQL — it was only shortlisted, never priced — and the current page carries no historical prices, so I can't say whether it changed.

Net effect on the comparison: ValeSQL is now $7/month cheaper than TernDB on the same basis (US, Launch, monthly billing), versus an unverified gap before.

**Sources**
- [S1](https://tern-current.example/pricing) — TernDB current pricing
- [S2](https://vale-current.example/pricing) — ValeSQL current pricing
- [tern-old](https://tern-old.example/pricing) — TernDB pricing as of Nov 3
